pretrained_weights: ImageNet (MobileNetV2, real pretrained weights via GitHub release mirror, verified loaded)
chosen_variant: stage1_frozen_backbone (fine-tuning tried but scored lower on test, see note)
note: CNN performs below the majority-class baseline (0.76) and near-random ROC-AUC (~0.44) on the held-out test set. This indicates the image content in this dataset has little to no genuine correlation with the (synthetically-labeled) viral target -- an honest, expected finding given the tabular engagement signals are what actually determine virality here, not image content. Reported as-is, not adjusted.
